d: Chhath Puja is one of India's most special festivals, dedicated to Lord Surya and Chhathi Maiya. Celebrated over four days, this festival brings families together through prayers, fasting and beautiful traditions. Join us as we explore each day of Chhath Puja — Nahay Khay, Kharna, Sandhya Arghya and Usha Arghya — and understand the significance of its rituals.
